study_note: 4 prior-training configurations comparing TD-AMBI reward-only versus entropy-augmented critics and fixed-temperature Q-normalized versus learned-temperature unnormalized actors. Each configuration runs one Humanoid Walk state trial with seed 55 and 2 million decisions. Prior-only collection uses the stochastic outer policy with no inner work; retain all checkpoints every 25,000 decisions. Scaled-entropy targets are explicitly -441 wherever alpha is learned, with outer alpha initialized to 1e-4. For entropy-augmented critics, the bonus is alpha*S*H_scaled when Q scaling is enabled and alpha*H_scaled otherwise. Algorithm files specify the complete learner settings; no partial alg_params override is applied. This is a single-seed exploratory study. Each completed run produces 80 scheduled checkpoints.
